text:
maria: Evening handoff — quick summary of today's incident (start ~18:03 UTC). We saw a spike in 5xxs caused by batcher OOMs leading to pod restarts and degraded responses. Incident window ~18:03–18:39 UTC.

incident-bot: page sent to @oncall at 18:05 and 18:12. Alerts: batcher_p95_mem and api_5xx_rate.

jon: Took first page. Root cause looked like continuous-batching memory accounting regression after last merge. Confirmed OOMs on batcher pods via k8s events.

sam: Assisted with temporary mitigations — lowered `batcher.max_batch_tokens` (1024 -> 512) via feature flag and disabled `continuous_big_batch` for heavy-traffic routes. Rolled small-model fallback for non-critical customers to reduce pressure.

maria: Mitigations applied: scaled batcher replicas 6 -> 12, applied feature flag, enabled fallback to `gpt-small-v1` for tiered traffic for 30m. Error rate fell from ~6% to ~0.4% by 18:39. No persistent data loss.

abby: Customer-impact update from CS: Acme and BetaCorp saw latency spikes and ~15% failed requests between 18:05-18:30. We informed Acme, they requested credit and a postmortem; they accepted provisional credit.

lee: I'll own the root-cause patch for the memory accounting (owner: lee). I opened ticket RINF-2394 for the fix and test coverage. Plan: add unit tests for kv-cache accounting + integration test in staging.

jon: Added a short-term monitoring rule and a runbook note. New alert: `batcher_p95_mem > 85% for 5m` -> page primary. Also created a dashboard panel for eviction_rate and batcher_p95_mem.

sam: Next steps for follow-up: create a canary with the patched accounting, tighten autoscale policy (scale-out faster, scale-in slower), and add a `max_batch_tokens` gating check in the API layer. I'll schedule the canary for tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for 2026-03-15 02:00 UTC (job #4521).

maria: Current status: services stable, autoscaler holding ~10 replicas, mem trending down. No active pages.

lee: I'll update the batcher runbook with the specific mitigation steps and the new alert links. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/batcher-memory (please update if you hit gaps).

maria: Short checklist for the oncoming shift:
- Primary: sam
- Secondary: jon
- Watch: `api_5xx_rate`, `batcher_p95_mem`, `eviction_rate` for next 4 hours
- If errors >1% for 15m, escalate to oncall@redwood and trigger fallback model by toggling `fallback_to_small=true`

sam: I'll be primary for the next shift. jon on standby. If anything escalates, ping me and @lee directly.

abby: CS follow-ups: I'll send the customer note and link to the postmortem when available.

maria: Ops/commands for quick checks (copy/paste):
```
# k8s pods
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=batcher -o wide
# recent OOM events
kubectl -n inference describe pods <batcher-pod> | grep -i oom
# metrics quick check
curl -sS "https://metrics.internal/api/v1/query?query=batcher_p95_mem" | jq .
```

jon: I added RINF-2394 and a small runbook PR at https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pull/78 — please review.

lee: I'll own the patch and will push a staging deploy with testing by EOD tomorrow.

maria: Coverage note: there's an APAC gap between 00:30–03:00 UTC where only on-call backup coverage is available. Lee agreed to be backup if any pages come in overnight.

maria: Handing off now. Please monitor dashboards and escalate if api_5xx_rate >1% sustained for 15m. I'm available on pager for 30m. :thumbsup: :eyes: :rotating_light:
